_comment: Hosts that belong to every project and therefore to none. Excluded from clustering entirely, never down-weighted. Matched on eTLD+1 or exact host. Read by both TS and Python. AI assistants (chatgpt, claude.ai, gemini, perplexity) are deliberately NOT here: a conversation tab has a project-specific title and is opened from, and switched with, the project it serves (DECISIONS 2026-09-15).
